rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1995). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1995).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S as 'P.G. Wodehouse'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. None to mild fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very double, cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, compact. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 20" to 35" (50 to 90cm).

rows.Notes: Author P.G. (Sir Pelham Grenville, affectionately known as "Plum") Wodehouse was born in Surrey, England, 15 October 1881. He died on Long Island 14 February 1975.
